verdict.rationale: Paddle's own hosted MCP server uses a codemode `execute` tool that runs a JavaScript function chaining one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation. This lets an agent apply an action across many items, such as many subscriptions, in one step. It is not documented as a dedicated bulk-operations feature, and the docs warn that destructive operations are not gated. Missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk API endpoints or documented bulk actions, explicit examples of multi-item operations, limits or rate-limit guidance for bulk runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
